# NOCTURE

> A concept candle atelier - a dark, cinematic storefront where every product sits in a lit alcove and opens into a full-screen scene. A design study by Aditya Kulkarni; the products shown are fictional.

## Links

- [Storefront](https://nocture-ten.vercel.app/)
- [Source](https://github.com/Aditya2375/nocture)

## Stack

Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript - no build step, no framework.
